content: The road of life is paved with cobblestones of patience, each one laid with prayer.
author: Persian Proverbs
explanation: A long highway across the desert is not paved with grand speeches, but with stone after stone set patiently in the mortar under scorching heat. Every time you swallow irritation, forgive an error, or persist through delay, you pave the highway of your soul.
practicalInsight: Lay one solid cobblestone of patience today. Meet a delay or disappointment with prayerful calm.
reflectionPrompt: What road in your life are you abandoning because you are tired of laying the quiet cobblestones of patience?
